Name: Nyapu-Style for Ginger Island NPC Overhaul
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
Description:
Exactly what it says on the tin.
Portrait variations selected via [b][i]Ginger Island NPC Overhaul[/i][/b]'s config options are automatically detected and applied.

[b][color=#ffe599][size=6]S[/size][/color][size=5][color=#ffe599]pecial Mod Interactions[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11247][i]Seasonal Improved Leo[/i][/url]: If you have it installed, Leo will have Nyapu-style seasonal portraits.
[/list][color=#b6d7a8][b]﻿[size=6]I[/size][size=5]nstallation[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][i]Content Patcher[/i][/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284][i]CMCT[/i][/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9242][i]Ginger Island NPC Overhaul[/i][/url] installed.
[*]Download [b][i]Nyapu-Style for Ginger Island NPC Overhaul[/i][/b].
[*]Extract the downloaded file into the game's [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Mods[/font] folder.
[/list]To uninstall, simply delete [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Nyapu Ginger Island Overhaul[/font] from your Mods folder.

[color=#b4a7d6][size=6][b]C[/b][/size][size=5][b]redits[/b][/size][/color][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/7439530]Zoedoll[/url]: original mod.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]Nyapu[/url]: base portrait art.
[*][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AhCuteArt?gameId=1303]AhCuteArt[/url]: Leo's seasonal portraits.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/90573338]Zilch[/url]: original designs for Leo's seasonal portraits.
[/list][b][color=#d5a6bd][size=6]S[/size][/color][size=5][color=#d5a6bd]pecial Thanks[/color][/size][/b]
To [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/kcspace]kcspace[/url], who provided a late game save file for me to test my mod in and take all the screenshots from.
